direct_sequence: 大統曆推夏至日出分二千六十八分三十秒
冬至日出分二千九百三十一分七十秒
夏至日出寅正四刻日入戌初初刻晝五十九刻夜四十一刻
冬至日出辰初初刻日入申正四刻晝四十一刻夜五十九刻
page_52.normalized_mechanical_reading: One physical passage explicitly places Datong solstitial sunrise-fen values 2068.30 / 2931.70 and the corresponding 59/41 / 41/59 whole-ke displays together, providing a direct later-Ming binding witness between continuous/fractional Datong endpoint coordinates and whole-ke endpoint display.
page_52.source_scope: This closes a physical later-Ming binding at the solstitial endpoint. It does not by itself expose the full interior 42-58 selection rule or the Sanming/Yueling Dahan/Yushui transition fingerprint.

comparison.consequence: The previously reconstructed C-II-N + Nanjing-59 composite architecture now has a direct later-Ming textual/physical bridge showing Datong endpoint fen values and 59/41 whole-ke output in one passage. The missing link is narrowed from existence of such a binding to its securely pre-1578 form, exact state-dependent mechanics, and the Sanming/Yueling transition fingerprint.

transmission_impact.lineage_scope: Direct physical later-Ming endpoint-binding control. Strong mechanical bridge, chronology insufficient for pre-1578 ancestry.

next_gate: Search a securely pre-1578 Nanjing/Datong, Tongshu/almanac, clepsydra/change-arrow, or official-calendar witness that binds the same endpoint layer before Sanming 1578.
Find the exact state-dependent rule that preserves the C-II-N interior 42-58 thresholds while producing 59 at the solstitial endpoint.
